key.summary: Glass on the IBus candidate popup

key.summary: Glass on the workspace switcher

key.name: blur-sigma
key.summary: Gaussian sigma of the backdrop blur, in pixels

key.name: tint-color
key.summary: Glass tint colour (hex)

key.name: tint-strength
key.summary: How strongly the tint is mixed into the backdrop

key.name: saturation
key.summary: Backdrop saturation multiplier

key.name: brightness
key.summary: Backdrop brightness multiplier

key.name: ior
key.summary: Index of refraction (1.5 = glass; 2.4 would be diamond)

key.name: refraction-strength
key.summary: Refraction displacement strength

key.name: bevel-width
key.summary: Width of the refracting edge bevel, in pixels; the centre stays undistorted

key.name: corner-radius
key.summary: Corner radius in pixels; -1 reads the radius from the surface's theme node

key.name: specular-enabled
key.summary: Specular highlights (off makes glass read as flat plastic)

key.name: specular-intensity
key.summary: Specular highlight intensity

key.name: specular-shininess
key.summary: Specular exponent; higher is tighter

key.name: chromatic-aberration
key.summary: Edge-only chromatic aberration amount

key.name: sheen-intensity
key.summary: Directional sheen gradient intensity

key.name: fresnel-intensity
key.summary: Fresnel rim-light intensity

key.name: shadow-enabled
key.summary: Soft drop shadow under the glass

key.name: shadow-opacity
key.summary: Drop shadow opacity

key.name: shadow-radius
key.summary: Drop shadow softness radius, in pixels

key.name: shadow-offset
key.summary: Drop shadow offset away from the light, in pixels

key.name: light-angle
key.summary: Light direction in degrees; 0 is from the top, increasing clockwise. Drives specular, rim and shadow together.

key.name: adaptive-text
key.summary: Adapt text colour to the backdrop behind the glass

key.name: text-mode
key.summary: Force light or dark text instead of measuring

key.name: text-threshold
key.summary: WCAG relative-luminance threshold for switching to dark text. 0.179 is the crossover where black and white text are equally legible.

key.name: text-hysteresis
key.summary: Total width of the dead band around the threshold, to stop borderline backdrops oscillating

key.name: text-shadow
key.summary: Add a matched text shadow under adapted text

key.name: fix-accent-contrast
key.summary: Darken accent-coloured chips that fail WCAG AA against their label

key.name: manage-blur-my-shell
key.summary: Offer to disable overlapping Blur My Shell components

key.name: manage-dash-to-dock
key.summary: Neutralise Dash to Dock's own background so it does not fade over the glass

key.name: blur-my-shell-backup
key.summary: JSON backup of Blur My Shell keys we changed, for a clean revert

key.name: dash-to-dock-backup
key.summary: JSON backup of Dash to Dock keys we changed, for a clean revert

key.name: native-blur
key.summary: Use the shell's native Gaussian blur; falls back to an in-shader blur if unavailable

key.name: min-refresh-interval
key.summary: Hard minimum interval between geometry refreshes of always-visible surfaces, in ms

key.name: hide-in-overview
key.summary: Hide panel glass while the Activities overview is open

key.name: debug-logging
key.summary: Verbose logging to the journal
